tail: Lead us to rest, O Lord our God, in peace, and let us rise, O our King, to life. Spread over us the tent of Thy peace and improve us through good counsel from before Thee. Help us for the sake of Thy Name, protect us and remove from us foe, pestilence, sword, famine and grief. Remove Satan from in front of us and behind us; and in the shadow of Thy wings shelter us, for Thou art God, our guardian and our deliverer, for Thou art God, a gracious and merciful King.
